Marissa — thanks. I think the conversion got mixed up: when you send invites from PDT, Google Calendar sometimes shows the event as the previous/next day for APAC folks depending on the recipient's calendar settings. For example, your "Mar 10 09:00 PDT" example shows as Mar 11 01:00 JST for us (which is outside our preferred window).

To avoid confusion can we:
1) Pick a local APAC time and have the invite created in that timezone (JST/SGT/AEDT) — that preserves the local day
2) Or use UTC in the invite title and body as a canonical reference

From our side, the first slot I listed (Mar 10, 10:00 JST) is still best for Tokyo and Singapore; Alex in Sydney can do 11:00 AEDT. Could you create the invite for Mar 10 10:00 JST and set the calendar timezone to Asia/Tokyo?

Kenji

On a side note: we're aware DST changes in Australia/US are coming up and it might shift things for a March/April cadence — happy to add a calendar note if we plan recurring syncs.
